notes: Corrected the infinitive clause from the day the king departed: הַמֶּלֶךְ is the infinitive's explicit subject and takes the king in its own units (rules 17, 15), rather than being marked unrepresented with its English folded into לֶכֶת.

The neither ... nor ... nor correlation is left as accepted, with the opening word on the present negative (rule 14) and the two later negatives unrepresented; the competing reading fuses each waw with its own negative into nor under rule 35, and is named here rather than adopted.
